nonzero_staging_evidence.scope: Previously generated synthetic remote CPU structural fixture; no nonzero real-GGUF anchor staging observed

storage_accounting.limit: Counter integer algebra and source MemoryWorkload wiring agree with previous synthetic demand evidence. New real-GGUF predictions do not retain every physical task resource demand. Aggregate resource_accounted_bytes includes multiple resource/cache layers, not unique DRAM bytes. An inactive/null ledger does not mean zero actual capacity or traffic.

f32_hidden_scope.common_weight_projection_rule: Explicit f32_storage sets activation_storage_bytes=4*M*K and output_bits=32 in _layer_gemm, shared by CPU/GPU lowering; imported packed weight bytes remain separate
covered_source_paths: LM head input; graph logits type remains explicit
already_f32: Source-specific Qwen3.5 QKV passes True directly
CPU27B host offload previously enabled F32 in R4; gather-only preserves it
separate_contracts: arithmetic precision and kernel dispatch/conversion throughput
f32_hidden_scope.limit: Enabled F32 flag plus source call-site inventory is not an exhaustive independent verification of every emitted CPU/GPU projection input/output and cross-device activation copy.
f32_hidden_scope.gather_only_scope: Intentional ablation: where prior F32 is absent, it produces F32 embedding output but does not propagate ordinary F32 hidden storage downstream
